cohort: 105 neonates admitted to the NICU of Combine Military Hospital (CMH), Quetta, between February 2022 to February 2023, with suspected neonatal sepsis.
finding: This study provides insights into the demographic and clinical characteristics of neonates with suspected sepsis.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the most common mode of delivery (47.6%), followed by cesarean section (42.9%).
